title: crataegus roanensis var. fluviatilis
intro: Crataegus roanensis var. fluviatilis, commonly known as the Roan Mountain hawthorn, is a variant of the Crataegus roanensis species. This plant is a type of hawthorn, a flowering shrub or small tree native to the southeastern United States. The health benefits of Crataegus roanensis var. fluviatilis include its potential to reduce cardiovascular stress, improve heart health, and lower blood pressure due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include vasodilation, reducing blood pressure, and improving lipid profiles, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
